dogecoin.text:
Last week, we saw a huge surge in the memecoin market, like @dogecoin jumping 25% in one week.

Memecoins lately:

🔵 Market value up 188% over the past year
🔵 Daily trading volume skyrocketing 800% over the past year
🔵 Transaction flows across all blockchains up 230% since

Memecoins, like @dogecoin and @ShibainuCoin, now trade around $10.7 billion DAILY. Compare that to NFTs, which have stalled at around $1.3 billion per month.

The numbers are clear: traders want liquidity, and memecoins offer it in spades​.
